resources.string: SkipFlow uses the Android Accessibility Service to detect when the official video skip button appears on screen and automatically taps it on your behalf when your hands are occupied (cooking, driving, working out, or for motor accessibility). SkipFlow NEVER collects, reads, or stores any personal data, keystrokes, or personal screen content.

SkipFlow requires Accessibility Service permission to function.

• Why is this needed? To automatically detect and tap the official 'Skip Ad' button when your hands are occupied (cooking, cleaning, working out, or due to motor assistance needs).

• Audio Control: Temporarily mutes media volume during ad playback if you have Smart Mute enabled.

• Privacy Guarantee: SkipFlow does NOT collect, transmit, or record any personal information, passwords, messages, or screen data. Everything happens locally on your device.
Taps skip as soon as the countdown finishes
Mutes volume during ads and restores when video resumes
Wave your hand over the proximity sensor to skip instantly
Disable battery optimization to prevent Android from closing SkipFlow in the background.
Add an intentional delay before clicking skip
